When you've wrapped both the head and tail of the car, then you've continued to stick to the trunk, which is very important, the main part of the car is empty, so it's easy to hit when you're moving, so you cut off two covers and cover the two sides of the trunk. Finally, you wrap up the rest of the car with a rearview and digital box.
Đầu tiên bạn dán phần đầu xe máy, luồn n.zh: 先是把摩托车的头部,从头部将盖子滑入车厢的后箱,再把车尾,总是从外出像头部一样. 将车头和车尾都包好后,再继续粘接后车厢,这非常重要,车厢主体为空地,因此行走时容易被撞到,因此切断了两个被子并覆盖后车厢两侧. 最后,你用后视和数字箱包住其余的车.
